lines.en: Part nine found an arrow in paths that no single moment shows. This part asks a sharper question: when does a new readout really add information?
lines.zh: 第九部在路径里找到了单个时刻看不见的箭头。这一部问一个更尖锐的问题：一个新的读口，什么时候才真正增加了信息？

lines.en: Two readouts can obey the same rule and still add different amounts. What counts is rank, and whether the arithmetic can still see it.
lines.zh: 两个读口可以满足同一条规则，却增加不同多的信息。真正算数的是秩，以及当前的算术还能不能看见它。

lines.en: The Auric FIB atom pyramid, part ten: rank, volume and arithmetic resolution.
lines.zh: Auric FIB 原子金字塔，第十部：秩、体积与算术分辨率。

lines.en: One hidden corner controls new dimensions, lifted volume and prime blind spots.
lines.zh: 一个隐藏的四角关系，同时控制新增维数、提升体积与素数盲区。

lines.en: Start on the nine-point plane over the field with three elements. Take f equal to u squared plus v squared, with a zero second coordinate, and g equal to u squared and v squared.
lines.zh: 从三元域上的九点平面开始。取 f 等于 u 平方加 v 平方、第二个坐标为零，再取 g 等于 u 平方与 v 平方。

lines.en: Along every line, both functions sum to something nonzero. They pass the same first-order sum-free rule, and Lean has checked it on every line.
lines.zh: 沿每一条直线，两个函数的和都不为零。它们满足同一条一阶 sum-free 规则，这一点 Lean 已在每条直线上检查过。

lines.en: But against the old readouts one, u and v, f adds one new function while g adds two. The spans have dimension four and five.
lines.zh: 但对已有的读数 1、u、v 来说，f 只新增一个函数，g 却新增两个。张成的维数分别是四和五。

lines.en: So their codes have dimension five and four. Lean has frozen this counterexample: the same legality does not fix the same dimension.
lines.zh: 所以它们的码维数是五和四。Lean 已冻结这个反例：同样的合法性，不决定同样的维数。

lines.en: Define new information as rank relative to the old boundary. What a new readout removes from the hidden freedom is the rank of its image modulo what was already read.
lines.zh: 把新增信息定义为相对于旧边界的秩。一个新读口从隐藏自由度中真正消掉的，是它模掉已有读数之后的秩。

lines.en: Repeating an old readout, changing its coordinates, or adding combinations of old ones removes nothing. The number of formulas is not the number of relations.
lines.zh: 重复旧读数、给它换坐标、或加入旧读数的组合，都消不掉任何自由度。公式的数量，不等于关系的数量。

lines.en: On the pyramid, the old boundary is one, low, high and middle. Every function on the five patterns is an affine part plus J times x y, where J is the four-corner difference: empty plus joint, minus low, minus high.
lines.zh: 在金字塔上，旧边界是 1、低端、高端和中间。五模式上的每个函数，都等于一个仿射部分加上 J 乘 x y；J 是四角差：空模式加联合，减低端，再减高端。

lines.en: So a new readout adds a dimension exactly when J is not zero. The hidden direction moves weight around four corners at once; no three patterns can compensate one another.
lines.zh: 所以新读口恰在 J 不为零时增加一维。隐藏方向同时在四个角之间挪动权重；任何三个模式都无法互相补偿。

lines.en: Second order is not automatically new. Low squared is still low, so squares add nothing. The product of two readouts adds only its cross term between the two ends.
lines.zh: 二阶不等于自动新增。低端的平方仍是低端，所以平方什么也没加。两个读口的乘积，只有两端之间的交叉项是新增的。

lines.en: Squaring one readout gives J equal to two a b. In characteristic two that vanishes for every readout, yet x y is still there, with J equal to one. What fails is the method, not the relation.
lines.zh: 一个读口的平方给出 J 等于 2ab。在特征二中，它对每个读口都为零，可是 x y 仍在，J 等于一。失效的是方法，不是关系。

lines.en: Lift each pattern by the value of f into four dimensions. Without a new relation, the five lifted points stay in one three-dimensional slice.
lines.zh: 把每个模式按 f 的值提升到四维。没有新增关系时，五个提升点仍停在同一个三维切片里。

lines.en: With one, they span a four-dimensional simplex of volume J over twenty-four. The same J sets the volume, but a bigger volume is still only one new dimension.
lines.zh: 有了新增关系，它们张成一个四维单纯形，体积是 J 除以二十四。同一个 J 决定体积，但体积再大，也只增加一维。

lines.en: Now count samples with integers. Two count vectors with the same old boundary differ by a multiple of the four-corner move, so the new readout sees J times that multiple.
lines.zh: 现在用整数计数样本。旧边界相同的两个计数向量，相差四角移动的整数倍，所以新读口看到的是 J 乘这个倍数。

lines.en: The reachable lattice has index J. Modulo m, each reachable boundary has the greatest common divisor of m and J preimages, so recovery is unique exactly when they are coprime. At finite p-adic precision, the p-adic valuation of J counts the digits lost.
lines.zh: 可达格点的指数是 J。模 m 时，每个可达边界恰有 m 与 J 的最大公约数那么多个原像，所以恰在二者互素时能唯一恢复。在有限 p 进精度下，J 的 p 进赋值就是丢掉的位数。

lines.en: Bring in FIB quantities. The stage readouts are N zero equals two x plus five y plus three z, N one equals three x plus eight y plus five z, and N three equals eight x plus twenty-one y plus thirteen z.
lines.zh: 代入 FIB 数量。阶段读数是 N0 等于 2x + 5y + 3z，N1 等于 3x + 8y + 5z，N3 等于 8x + 21y + 13z。

lines.en: Squaring N zero gives J equal to twenty, blind modulo two and five. Two samples, empty with joint against low with high, read forty-nine and twenty-nine: different over the integers, identical modulo two or five.
lines.zh: N0 的平方给出 J 等于二十，模二、模五时失明。两组样本，空模式加联合，对比低端加高端，读数是四十九和二十九：在整数里不同，模二或模五后完全相同。

lines.en: N one squared gives forty-eight and N three squared gives three hundred thirty-six. Together with N zero squared they still share the factor four, so a binary digit stays lost.
lines.zh: N1 的平方给出四十八，N3 的平方给出三百三十六。它们与 N0 的平方合在一起，仍共有因子四，所以仍丢掉一个二进位。

lines.en: The mixed product N zero times N one has J equal to thirty-one, coprime to twenty, and recovers x y with no division. But it needs both readings on the same source, and its large coefficients can amplify noise.
lines.zh: 混合乘积 N0 乘 N1 的 J 是三十一，与二十互素，不用除法就能恢复 x y。但它需要同一来源上的两个读数，而且大系数可能放大噪声。

lines.en: Watch the native readout along its three-step stages. Fibonacci numbers repeat modulo two every three steps, so every stage reading, modulo two, equals y plus z.
lines.zh: 沿原生的三步阶段观察读数。Fibonacci 数模二每三步重复一次，所以每个阶段读数模二都等于 y 加 z。

lines.en: Repeat it forever, process it however you like, and the x y relation never appears. Turning one distorted scalar around cannot add what it lost.
lines.zh: 无论重复多少次、怎样加工，x y 关系都不会出现。反复摆弄一份已经失真的标量，补不回它丢掉的东西。

lines.en: But the native reader has another reply: rejection. Keep the current parity, then feed the high pattern. The guard rejects exactly when the seam left by the first window is one, and that seam is x.
lines.zh: 但原生读者还有另一种回复：拒绝。保存当前的奇偶，再输入高端模式。守卫恰在第一个窗口留下的接缝为一时拒绝，而这个接缝就是 x。

lines.en: Remainder one followed by rejection happens only for the joint pattern: y plus z, times x, is x y. Keeping the guard's reply on the same source reads what more scalar processing never could.
lines.zh: 余数为一、随后被拒绝，只发生在联合模式上：y 加 z 再乘 x，就是 x y。在同一来源上保留守卫的回复，就读到了再多标量加工也读不到的关系。

lines.en: Compare two boundaries of rank four. The occupancy boundary, one, x, y and z, draws the familiar pyramid. The native parity behavior gives one, x, y plus z and x y, and draws a tetrahedron of volume one sixth.
lines.zh: 比较两个秩都为四的边界。占位边界 1、x、y、z 画出熟悉的金字塔。原生奇偶行为给出 1、x、y+z 和 x y，画出一个体积六分之一的四面体。

lines.en: They share only three directions. The pyramid separates middle from high but misses x y; the tetrahedron keeps x y but merges middle and high. Together they recover all five pattern probabilities.
lines.zh: 它们只共享三个方向。金字塔区分中间与高端，却漏掉 x y；四面体保留 x y，却把中间与高端合并。二者合起来，恢复全部五模式概率。

lines.en: Quantum readouts hide a similar trap. Any real combination of X and Y squares to a multiple of the identity, so its average never sees the state.
lines.zh: 量子读口里也藏着类似的陷阱。X 与 Y 的任意实组合，平方都是单位矩阵的倍数，所以它的平均值永远看不见态。

lines.en: Their order still matters: the commutator of X and Y, over two i, is Z. Here the cancellation comes from anticommutation, not from two equal to zero, and reading Z still needs an actual measurement.
lines.zh: 可它们的次序仍然有关：X 与 Y 的对易子除以 2i 就是 Z。这里的抵消来自反对易，而不是二等于零；而且要读出 Z，仍需要实际的测量。

lines.en: Ask three questions of any new relation. Does it add rank? Can the current precision see it? And will an actual future operation read it again?
lines.zh: 对任何一个新关系，都问三个问题：它增加秩了吗？当前精度看得见吗？实际的后续操作还会再读到它吗？

lines.en: The ternary counterexample is frozen in Lean. The four-corner analysis, the volumes, the lattices and the guard reading are argued in the theory volume, and every number here was recomputed for this film.
lines.zh: 三元平面上的反例已在 Lean 中冻结。四角分析、体积、格点与守卫读出在理论卷中论证，这里的每个数字都为这部片子重新计算过。
